scope: PLANNING ONLY; no existing GUI source/test changes

AUTH.requirement: OPC UA actions require existing explicit organization/operator authorization; denied actions invoke no network client.
AUTH.acceptance: Retain denied adapter call-count zero; allow a manually authorized read-only loopback action; no write capability.

ISOLATION.requirement: DEMO and LIVE inventories, evidence and late callbacks cannot cross modes or write private LIVE config.
ISOLATION.acceptance: Use actual current mode IDs; switch modes before completing callback; compare LIVE values/evidence and private config bytes.

COMMUNICATION.requirement: Active F3 uses local read-only API; structured committed evidence controls flow and animation; selection/navigation starts no collector.
COMMUNICATION.acceptance: Exercise active F3ApiView and API provenance, listener lifetime, explicit manual action, and no probe/collector on open/select/close.

PROVENANCE.requirement: UNKNOWN is not offline; WAN/session/read/link states need structured evidence; pulses require committed events.
PROVENANCE.source: aqua-command-desktop/desktop/f3_network.py: evidence parsing, edge render and event pulse; F3 API source contracts
PROVENANCE.acceptance: Flags, unverified WAN and stale/missing evidence never create verified connectivity; committed receipts alone can animate.

TAG_LOADING.requirement: Private Tag import and exact mapping load work without a repository catalog; empty first run remains usable.
TAG_LOADING.source: aqua-command-desktop/desktop/app.py: scan_wincc_tags and private mapping precedence; desktop/private_runtime.py; opcua_mapping.py
TAG_LOADING.acceptance: Inject a test-owned synthetic catalog for legacy GUI fixtures; separately check empty first run and private mapping persistence without site fixture dependence.

NAVIGATION.requirement: F1/F2/F3/F6 navigation, close/reopen, owned details/settings and paged layout follow the accepted active-view contract.
NAVIGATION.acceptance: Retain access to every configured device across pages, unclipped active controls, owner close behavior and no orphan API/listener.
